name: El Al Israel Airlines Ltd.
summary: El Al Israel Airlines Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides passenger and cargo transportation services. It operates flights on passenger and cargo in countries in Europe, the United States, Asia, and Africa. The company offers aircraft maintenance services; sells duty-free products; produces and supplies food to airlines; security services to aviation; and operates a loyalty program. It also produces and supplies prepared kosher meals to airlines, cruise companies, and institutions. In addition, the company markets vacation packages. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Lod, Israel.
